Article landing page

A publisher's landing page names its article by DOI in the head (citation_doi, dc.identifier) and in the text. An open-access finder (Unpaywall, LibKey Nomad) reads the DOI here, asks its service for a free copy and draws its tab over the page.

DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0000308

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs. How vexingly quick daft zebras jump. Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
